title: Solve complex resistor networks

hook.scenario: Agar ek raste par 2 toll booth hain, aur aage chal kar rasta do mein bat jata hai.
hook.question: Mixed circuit ko solve karne ke liye kahan se shuru karna chahiye?

mental_model.intuition: Complex circuits ek puzzle ki tarah hain. Andar se bahar ki taraf solve karte hain.
mental_model.description: Pehle sabse obvious chote loops ko identify karo: kya yeh do resistors pakka series mein hain ya parallel mein? Unhe ek single equivalent resistor se replace karo. Phir naye simplified circuit ko dubara solve karo.

explanation:
Practical problems mein aksar circuits na toh purely series hote hain, na purely parallel. Dono ka mixture hote hain. Ise solve karne ka koi ek formula nahi hai, balki step-by-step approach chahiye.

Rule 1: Circuit diagram ko dhyan se dekho aur un resistors ko dhoondo jinke beech kahin koi branch/joint nahi hai. Woh pakka series mein hain. Unka Rs nikal kar unhe ek single resistor se replace kar do.

Rule 2: Un resistors ko dhoondo jinke dono ends ek hi common point par jude hain. Woh parallel mein hain. Unka Rp nikal kar unhe replace kar do.

Rule 3: Is process ko tab tak repeat karte raho jab tak poora circuit ek single resistance R_eq na ban jaye. Iske baad aap battery ka voltage (V) use karke total current (I = V/R_eq) nikal sakte hain.

key_points.title: Identify clear sub-networks
key_points.detail: Always look for resistors that are unambiguously in series (no branches between them) or in parallel (connected to the exact same two nodes).

key_points.title: Redraw
key_points.detail: Mentally or physically redraw the circuit replacing a block of resistors with their equivalent resistance.

worked_example.problem: How can three resistors of resistances 2 ohm, 3 ohm, and 6 ohm be connected to give a total resistance of (a) 4 ohm, (b) 1 ohm?

steps.narration: (a) 4 ohm laane ke liye: 3 aur 6 ko parallel mein jodo.
Phir us 2 ohm ko pehle wale 2 ohm ke saath series mein laga do.
(b) 1 ohm laane ke liye: teeno ko parallel mein jod do.

worked_example.answer: (a) 3 ohm & 6 ohm in parallel, connected in series with 2 ohm. (b) All three in parallel.

worked_example.problem: In a circuit, R1 = 10 ohm and R2 = 40 ohm are in parallel. They are connected in series to a combination of R3 = 30 ohm, R4 = 20 ohm, and R5 = 60 ohm which are also in parallel. Find total resistance.

steps.narration: Pehle R1 aur R2 ka parallel combination Rp1 nikalte hain.
Phir R3, R4, R5 ka parallel combination Rp2 nikalte hain.
Dono equivalent blocks series mein hain, inko add karte hain.

common_mistakes.title: Treating a branch as series
common_mistakes.explanation: Agar do resistors ke beech koi junction aa jaye jahan current split ho sakta hai, toh wo resistors series mein nahi hote.

recall_questions.q: If you need an equivalent resistance smaller than any of the available resistors, how should you connect them?
What is the first step in solving a complex resistor network?
recall_questions.answer: Identify which resistors are purely in series or purely in parallel.

recall_questions.q: How do you simplify a series-parallel combination?
recall_questions.answer: Solve the simplest inner branches first and replace them with their equivalent resistance.

oa_questions.question: What is the (a) highest, (b) lowest total resistance that can be secured by combinations of four coils of resistance 4 ohm, 8 ohm, 12 ohm, 24 ohm?
oa_questions.answer: (a) Highest: Series = 48 ohm. (b) Lowest: Parallel = 2 ohm.

oa_questions.question: Two 2Ω resistors in parallel are connected in series with a 3Ω resistor. What is the total resistance?
